Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
reyda wrote:
>
> hi =)
> i need the answer really fast =)
>
> I play Spirit Marionette on a minion that cannot act (say, a paranoid !malk)
> when do i give back the minion ?

At the end of the next action.

> i guess i keep it until i act again no ?

Or until someone acts.

> that means i can have it till my next turn or till game ends if i tak no
> further actions, huh ? =)

Only if no one takes any actions until that time.
